newsitem.title: USA: Big Stone, 440 MW S.D. plant seen fully back Sun.
newsitem.headline: Big Stone, 440 MW S.D. plant seen fully back Sun.

text.p: The 440 megawatt Big Stone coal-fired power plant in Big Stone City, S.D., will likely return to full service on Sunday after scheduled maintenance, a Northwestern Public Service spokesman said.
"It is in the startup phase right now so it is producing at varying levels of power during testing, but it should be up for good by Sunday," Northwestern spokesman Richard Green said Wednesday.
Northwestern operates and holds at 23.4 percent interest in the plant, while Otter Tail Power Co holds 53.9 percent and Montana-Dakota Utilities Co holds the remaining 22.7 percent.
The plant, located in northeast South Dakota near the Minnesota border, was shut Sept 5 for the scheduled maintenance.
